_comment: Prior-year final closes, used to compute YTD for instruments whose data source gives no history. Update once each January. TASI 2025 close per Tadawul's annual statistical report (12,036.50 at end-2024, -12.84% over 2025).
_comment2: CSI 300 baseline derived from the PC feed (close / (1 + YTD%)) on 9 Oct 2026; used only if the history feed is unavailable.
